technique_name: Develop a plan to reduce electricity usage in a home.
description: A plan to reduce electricity usage in a home can include a number of different strategies. These include replacing inefficient lightbulbs with energy-efficient LEDs, unplugging appliances and electronics when not in use, using natural light instead of electric lights where possible, using a touch-free faucet to reduce water heater use, using a smart thermostat to monitor and adjust temperatures automatically, installing a solar hot water heater, and turning off electronics when not in use.
